subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Tea as Global Connector
description: Learn Tea as Global Connector in one minute.

hook.text: Every inhabited continent has a tea tradition. No other drink is prepared in so many different ways by so many people.

buildup.text: China whisks, India boils, Britain steeps, Morocco pours, Japan meditates. Same leaf, radically different rituals.

discovery.text: Tea crossed cultures through trade, colonialism, migration, and religion—adapting to each society while keeping its core identity.

twist.text: Despite globalization, local tea cultures are strengthening. People want both Starbucks and grandma’s recipe.

climax.text: The United Nations designated May 21 as International Tea Day—recognizing tea's role in economies, health, and cultural identity.

punchline.text: One plant, one world, infinite traditions. Tea connects everyone.

details.summary: Tea is consumed in virtually every country on Earth, making it the most universally shared beverage after water. From Japanese matcha to Moroccan mint to Indian chai, tea connects billions of people through a shared plant prepared in endlessly diverse ways.
details.whyItMatters: Tea's universality makes it perhaps the most powerful cultural connector on the planet. One plant, thousands of traditions, and billions of daily rituals unite humanity.
takeaways: Tea is consumed in virtually every country on Earth
One plant is prepared in endlessly diverse cultural ways
It transcends religious, cultural, and geographic boundaries

faq.question: How many people drink tea worldwide?
faq.answer: Over 2 billion people drink tea daily. It is the world's most consumed beverage after water. Annual consumption exceeds 6 billion kilograms. From morning chai in India to afternoon tea in England to evening green tea in Japan, tea punctuates daily life across the globe.

faq.question: What makes tea so universally popular?
faq.answer: Tea is affordable, easy to prepare, and adaptable to any culture's tastes. It can be sweet or bitter, hot or cold, simple or ceremonial. It contains enough caffeine to be stimulating but not so much as to be jarring. Its versatility and gentle nature make it welcome everywhere.
